Implement pub async fn check_email_push_change<B: EmailPushBackend>(backend: &B, caller, old: Option<&PushSubscription>, new: &mut PushSubscription) -> Result<(), BackendSetError<B::Error>> in emailpush/validate.rs. There is no check_push_subscription_change hook (decision 16): the deployment's create_push_subscription (old None) and update_push_subscription (old = stored, new = patched) MUST call it before storing, as chat backends call validate_chat_push; the rustdoc says MUST. No side effects. The change includes emailPush when new has the key on create, or old and new differ in emailPush on update; otherwise only rule (5) runs (the account check runs only when the change touches emailPush). Otherwise: a non-object value => path emailPush; rule 5: non-null and keys None => add "keys"; load email_push_accounts once; for each key A: unknown account or non-object config => emailPush/A; filter must decode as Option<EmailFilter>, stay within jmap_server::MAX_FILTER_DEPTH (filter_nests_deeper_than) and use only supported conditions (mail: every EmailCondition; non-mail: the 10 required + inMailbox* when object_ids + filter_conditions; metadata conditions also need metadata_info::<Email>(caller, A); create/update receive no using, so there is no metadata-in-using gate, decision 16) else emailPush/A/filter; properties must decode as Vec<String> and each pass project::check_email_property (bodyValues always fails; non-mail: the 8-name minimum + id/threadId/mailboxIds when object_ids + declared extras; objectHistory passes only when mail && email_history, decision 10) else emailPush/A/properties; urgency must decode as Urgency else emailPush/A/urgency. Collect every bad path: one SetError invalidProperties ["emailPush", paths in map order, "keys" for rule 5]. On success rewrite extra["emailPush"] as the normalized BTreeMap<Id, EmailPushConfig> (defaults filled, decision 9), with every objectHistory removed from properties and the other names kept in order (decision 10). E1's generic echo returns it in created/updated (decision 16). Factor the per-config checks that need no backend call (decode, depth, conditions and properties allowed for an EmailPushAccount) into pub fn check_email_push_config, shared with delivery (E8 skips configs that fail it, decision 16).
